blockingFindings.description: V123 resolves the measured negative signed-clearance samples on the front bodice in the 0.735–1.120 m range, but the neutral, arms-up and three-quarter renders still show irregular gray triangular facets at the lower front/side waist. A positive sampled distance does not establish continuous visible fabric or fit.
Both side views show the jacket hem projecting outward above the skirt; the back view shows an uneven layered rear-waist transition.

Crouch and sit views expose folded strips and tangled geometry below and behind the skirt; prone has a broad disk-like flare. The skirt remains cone-like rather than visibly pleated, and lamé/fencing-practice identity is not legible.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
